guard.name: guard
lines: Welcome to the Acropolis. Please keep to the paths.
Marble is very old. Look with your eyes, not your hands.
Nobody is allowed to skateboard here. Not even Athena.
Mrrp. Athens has more cats than columns.
Purr. This sunny stone is mine. Find your own.
I have lived here for nine lives. This is the best one.
Did you bring fish? No? Then mrrp.
Pericles had a cat. Probably. I like to think so.
Tourists take my photo. I take their lap.
The Parthenon is a very good place to nap.
Meow. In Greek we say 'gata'. Same thing, fewer whiskers.

koulouri.name: koulouri
lines: Koulouri! Sesame bread rings, fresh this morning!
One euro, still warm. Best breakfast in Athens!
Koulouri, koulouri! Eat one on the way up the hill!

tourists.name: tourist
photoLines: Can you take our photo, please?
Excuse me! Photo? The Parthenon is behind us.
Perfect. Efharisto! That is Greek for thank you.
Could you take one with the whole temple in it?
Lovely. We came all the way from far away.
chatLines: Is this the real Parthenon? It is much bigger than on the postcard.
It is so hot. Where is the shade?
My feet hurt. Those are a lot of steps.

figures.name: leontion
lines: I am Leontion. I write books of philosophy, and the Garden lets women in.
Epicurus says pleasure is a calm mind and good friends.

figures.name: epicurus
lines: Bread, water and friends. What more could one want?
Do not fear the gods or death. Enjoy the quiet.

figures.name: mys
lines: I am Mys. They say I was a slave once, but in this Garden I study with the others.
Slowly, slowly. That is the secret to everything.
I was here when the Stoa was built. Or maybe last week.
tortoise.friend: A tortoise follows you. Tortoise Friend sticker!

sleepingCat.purr: Purrrr... the cat stretches and a feather slips from under its paw!

areopagus.text: The sky glows. Orestes runs past, chased by shadows... then Athena's owl calls and they fade.
